title: Add values across rows
summary: T-SQL: Add values across rows. Add another row with 5.
introduction: SUM adds a column over the selected rows. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Add values across rows with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.

blocks.title: Add values across rows
blocks.code: SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM (VALUES (2), (3), (4)) AS numbers(n);

blocks.text: SUM adds the three selected numbers to make 9.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: SUM ignores NULL inputs; it does not treat them as a known zero.
